### Defining functions
```{r Making_Plotting_Function, include=FALSE, warning = FALSE, message=FALSE}
plot_stage <- function(stage_name, data, ann_colors) {
  
  df <- data %>%
    filter(Stage == stage_name)
  
  ggplot(df, aes(x = Timepoint, y = log2CPM)) +
    
    geom_boxplot(
      aes(fill = Species, group = interaction(Timepoint, Species)),
      position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
      alpha = 0.3,
      outlier.shape = NA
    ) +
    
    scale_fill_manual(values = ann_colors$species_cor) +
    
    geom_jitter(
      aes(color = Individual),
      position = position_jitterdodge(
        jitter.width = 0.15,
        dodge.width = 0.8
      ),
      size = 1,
      alpha = 0.6
    ) +
    
    scale_color_manual(values = ann_colors$individual_cor) +
    
    geom_line(
      stat = "summary",
      fun = mean,
      aes(group = Species, linetype = Species),
      position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
      linewidth = 1
    ) +
    
    scale_linetype_manual(values = c(C = "dotted", H = "solid")) +
    
    geom_point(
      stat = "summary",
      fun = mean,
      aes(shape = Species),
      position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
      size = 2
    ) +
    
    facet_wrap(~ Gene, scales = "free_y") +
    
    theme_classic() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
    
    ggtitle(stage_name)
}
```

### Unfiltered

#### No4
```{r}

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggsignif)

RNA_fc <- readRDS("data/QC/concat/RNA_fc.RDS")

metadata <- RNA_Metadata_No4
counts <- RNA_fc %>% 
  dplyr::select(-contains("Day4"))

# Make sure metadata follows the count matrix
metadata <- metadata[
    match(colnames(counts), metadata$SampleName),
]

metadata <- metadata %>% 
  filter(Individual != "H4R")

counts <- counts %>% 
  dplyr::select(-contains("R"))


Cor_log2cpm <- readRDS(
  "data/QC/concat/Cor_Raw_No4_NoRep.RDS"
)


sample_info <- data.frame(
  sample    = colnames(Cor_log2cpm),
  species   = metadata$Species,
  timepoint = metadata$Timepoint
)


cor_long <- as.data.frame(Cor_log2cpm) %>%
  mutate(sample1 = rownames(Cor_log2cpm)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    -sample1,
    names_to = "sample2",
    values_to = "cor"
  ) %>%
  filter(sample1 != sample2) %>%
  left_join(
    sample_info,
    by = c("sample1" = "sample")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    species1 = species,
    timepoint1 = timepoint
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    sample_info,
    by = c("sample2" = "sample")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    species2 = species,
    timepoint2 = timepoint
  )


same_day_cross <- cor_long %>%
  filter(
    species1 != species2,
    timepoint1 == timepoint2
  ) %>%
  filter(species1 == "H") %>% 
  mutate(
    timepoint1 = factor(
      timepoint1,
      levels = c("Day0","Day2","Day5","Day15","Day30")
    )
  )


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Summary statistics
# ---------------------------------------------------------

summary_by_day <- same_day_cross %>%
  group_by(timepoint1) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_cor = mean(cor, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_cor = sd(cor, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n()
  )

summary_by_day


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Kruskal-Wallis test
# ---------------------------------------------------------

kruskal_res <- kruskal.test(
  cor ~ timepoint1,
  data = same_day_cross
)

kruskal_res


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# ALL pairwise Wilcoxon rank-sum tests
# ---------------------------------------------------------

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
# install.packages("rstatix")
library(rstatix)
# install.packages("ggpubr")
library(ggpubr)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Pairwise Wilcoxon tests with BH correction
# ---------------------------------------------------------

stat.test <- same_day_cross %>%
  pairwise_wilcox_test(
    cor ~ timepoint1,
    p.adjust.method = "BH"
  ) %>%
  add_significance("p.adj") %>% 
  add_y_position()

stat.test

# Keep only significant comparisons if desired
stat.test <- stat.test %>%
  filter(p.adj <= 0.05)


stat.test

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Plot
# ---------------------------------------------------------

plot <- ggplot(
  same_day_cross,
  aes(
    x = timepoint1,
    y = cor
  )
) +

  geom_boxplot(
    outlier.shape = NA
  ) +

  geom_jitter(
    width = 0.15,
    alpha = 0.4
  ) +

 stat_pvalue_manual(
    stat.test,
    label = "p.adj.signif",
    step.increase = 0.07
  ) +

  coord_cartesian(
    ylim = c(0.8, 1.00)
  ) +

  labs(
    title = "Cross-species (Human vs Chimp) correlation, matched timepoints \nUnfiltered \nDay5 Cardiac Mesoderm \nkruskal.test pairwise_wilcox_test \n(p.adj=BH)",
    x = "Timepoint",
    y = "Spearman correlation"
  ) +

  theme_classic()

plot

ggsave(
  "purity_plot.pdf",
  plot = plot,
  width = 5,
  height = 5
)

```

## Log2cpm Filtered

### All
#### Correlations
```{r}

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggsignif)

metadata <- RNA_Metadata
counts <- Filt_logcpm_G1_SpTp_RNA_fc

# Make sure metadata follows the count matrix
metadata <- metadata[
    match(colnames(counts), metadata$SampleName),
]

metadata <- metadata %>% 
  filter(Individual != "H4R")

counts <- counts %>% 
  dplyr::select(-contains("R"))


Cor_log2cpm <- readRDS(
  "data/QC/concat/Cor_Filt_logcpm_G1_SpTp_RNA_TMM_log2cpm_NoRep.RDS"
)


sample_info <- data.frame(
  sample    = colnames(Cor_log2cpm),
  species   = metadata$Species,
  timepoint = metadata$Timepoint
)


cor_long <- as.data.frame(Cor_log2cpm) %>%
  mutate(sample1 = rownames(Cor_log2cpm)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    -sample1,
    names_to = "sample2",
    values_to = "cor"
  ) %>%
  filter(sample1 != sample2) %>%
  left_join(
    sample_info,
    by = c("sample1" = "sample")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    species1 = species,
    timepoint1 = timepoint
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    sample_info,
    by = c("sample2" = "sample")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    species2 = species,
    timepoint2 = timepoint
  )


same_day_cross <- cor_long %>%
  filter(
    species1 != species2,
    timepoint1 == timepoint2
  ) %>%
  filter(species1 == "H") %>% 
  mutate(
    timepoint1 = factor(
      timepoint1,
      levels = c("Day0","Day2","Day4","Day5","Day15","Day30")
    )
  )


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Summary statistics
# ---------------------------------------------------------

summary_by_day <- same_day_cross %>%
  group_by(timepoint1) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_cor = mean(cor, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_cor = median(cor, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_cor = sd(cor, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n()
  )

summary_by_day


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Kruskal-Wallis test
# ---------------------------------------------------------

kruskal_res <- kruskal.test(
  cor ~ timepoint1,
  data = same_day_cross
)
```

```{r , fig.width=5,fig.height=5}
Cor_log2cpm <- readRDS("data/QC/concat/Cor_Filt_logcpm_G1_SpTp_RNA_TMM_log2cpm_NoRep.RDS")

H_samples <- grep("^H", colnames(Cor_log2cpm), value = TRUE)
C_samples <- grep("^C", colnames(Cor_log2cpm), value = TRUE)

H_C_cor <- expand.grid(
  H_sample = H_samples,
  C_sample = C_samples,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

H_C_cor$Spearman <- mapply(
  function(h, c) Cor_log2cpm[h, c],
  H_C_cor$H_sample,
  H_C_cor$C_sample
)

H_C_cor$H_timepoint <- sub("^.*_(Day.*)$", "\\1", H_C_cor$H_sample)
H_C_cor$C_timepoint <- sub("^.*_(Day.*)$", "\\1", H_C_cor$C_sample)

head(H_C_cor)

timepoint_order <- c(
  "Day0", "Day2", "Day4","Day5", "Day15", "Day30"
)

H_C_cor$H_timepoint <- factor(
  H_C_cor$H_timepoint,
  levels = timepoint_order
)

H_C_cor$C_timepoint <- factor(
  H_C_cor$C_timepoint,
  levels = timepoint_order
)


table(H_C_cor$H_timepoint, H_C_cor$C_timepoint)


library(ggplot2)

ggplot(
  subset(H_C_cor, H_timepoint == "Day0"),
  aes(x = C_timepoint, y = Spearman, group = 1)
) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(
    x = "Chimpanzee developmental timepoint",
    y = "Spearman correlation",
    title = "Human Day0 vs. chimpanzee developmental trajectory"
  )

ggplot(
  H_C_cor,
  aes(x = C_timepoint, y = Spearman, group = H_timepoint, color = H_timepoint)
) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(
    x = "Chimpanzee developmental timepoint",
    y = "Spearman correlation",
    color = "Human timepoint"
  )

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

H_C_cor_median <- H_C_cor %>%
  group_by(H_timepoint, C_timepoint) %>%
  summarise(
    Median_Spearman = median(Spearman, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ggplot(
  H_C_cor_median,
  aes(
    x = C_timepoint,
    y = Median_Spearman,
    group = H_timepoint,
    color = H_timepoint
  )
) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(
    x = "Chimpanzee developmental timepoint",
    y = "Median Spearman correlation",
    color = "Human timepoint"
  )


H_C_cor_median <- H_C_cor %>%
  group_by(H_timepoint, C_timepoint) %>%
  summarise(
    Median_Spearman = median(Spearman, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ggplot(
  H_C_cor_median,
  aes(
    x = C_timepoint,
    y = H_timepoint,
    fill = Median_Spearman
  )
) +
  geom_tile() +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", Median_Spearman)),
    size = 3
  ) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    limits = c(0, 1),
    name = "Spearman\ncorrelation"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(
    x = "Chimpanzee developmental timepoint",
    y = "Human developmental timepoint"
  )
```

#### Mixed Model Effects

```{r}
same_day_cross <- H_C_cor %>%
  filter(H_timepoint == C_timepoint) %>%
  mutate(
    H_individual = sub("_.*", "", H_sample),
    C_individual = sub("_.*", "", C_sample),
    timepoint = factor(
      H_timepoint,
      levels = c("Day0", "Day2", "Day4", "Day5", "Day15", "Day30")
    )
  )

table(same_day_cross$timepoint)

same_day_cross <- same_day_cross %>%
  mutate(
    pair = interaction(H_individual, C_individual, drop = TRUE)
  )

# BiocManager::install("lme4")
library(lme4)


model <- lmer(
  Spearman ~ timepoint +
    (1 | H_individual) +
    (1 | C_individual) +
    (1 | pair),
  data = same_day_cross
)

summary(model)

model_no_pair <- lmer(
  Spearman ~ timepoint +
    (1 | H_individual) +
    (1 | C_individual),
  data = same_day_cross
)

summary(model_no_pair)

same_day_cross <- same_day_cross %>%
  mutate(Spearman_z = atanh(Spearman))

summary(same_day_cross$Spearman_z)

model_z <- lmer(
  Spearman_z ~ timepoint +
    (1 | H_individual) +
    (1 | C_individual),
  data = same_day_cross
)

summary(model_z)

same_day_cross <- same_day_cross %>%
  mutate(
    window = case_when(
      timepoint %in% c("Day0") ~ "Early",
      timepoint %in% c("Day2", "Day4", "Day5") ~ "Middle",
      timepoint %in% c("Day15", "Day30") ~ "Late"
    ),
    window = factor(window, levels = c("Early", "Middle", "Late"))
  )

table(same_day_cross$timepoint, same_day_cross$window)

model_window <- lmer(
  Spearman_z ~ window +
    (1 | H_individual) +
    (1 | C_individual),
  data = same_day_cross
)

summary(model_window)

same_day_cross <- same_day_cross %>%
  mutate(
    window_middle_ref = relevel(window, ref = "Middle")
  )

model_window_middle <- lmer(
  Spearman_z ~ window_middle_ref +
    (1 | H_individual) +
    (1 | C_individual),
  data = same_day_cross
)

summary(model_window_middle)
```


### No4
```{r , fig.width=5,fig.height=5}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggsignif)

metadata <- RNA_Metadata_No4
counts <- Filt_logcpm_G1_SpTp_RNA_fc_No4

# Make sure metadata follows the count matrix
metadata <- metadata[
    match(colnames(counts), metadata$SampleName),
]

metadata <- metadata %>% 
  filter(Individual != "H4R")

counts <- counts %>% 
  dplyr::select(-contains("R"))


Cor_log2cpm <- readRDS(
  "data/QC/concat/Cor_Filt_logcpm_G1_SpTp_RNA_TMM_log2cpm_No4_NoRep.RDS"
)


sample_info <- data.frame(
  sample    = colnames(Cor_log2cpm),
  species   = metadata$Species,
  timepoint = metadata$Timepoint
)


cor_long <- as.data.frame(Cor_log2cpm) %>%
  mutate(sample1 = rownames(Cor_log2cpm)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    -sample1,
    names_to = "sample2",
    values_to = "cor"
  ) %>%
  filter(sample1 != sample2) %>%
  left_join(
    sample_info,
    by = c("sample1" = "sample")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    species1 = species,
    timepoint1 = timepoint
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    sample_info,
    by = c("sample2" = "sample")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    species2 = species,
    timepoint2 = timepoint
  )


same_day_cross <- cor_long %>%
  filter(
    species1 != species2,
    timepoint1 == timepoint2
  ) %>%
  filter(species1 == "H") %>% 
  mutate(
    timepoint1 = factor(
      timepoint1,
      levels = c("Day0","Day2","Day5","Day15","Day30")
    )
  )


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Summary statistics
# ---------------------------------------------------------

summary_by_day <- same_day_cross %>%
  group_by(timepoint1) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_cor = mean(cor, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_cor = median(cor, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_cor = sd(cor, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n()
  )

summary_by_day


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Kruskal-Wallis test
# ---------------------------------------------------------

kruskal_res <- kruskal.test(
  cor ~ timepoint1,
  data = same_day_cross
)

kruskal_res


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# ALL pairwise Wilcoxon rank-sum tests
# ---------------------------------------------------------

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
# install.packages("rstatix")
library(rstatix)
# install.packages("ggpubr")
library(ggpubr)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Pairwise Wilcoxon tests with BH correction
# ---------------------------------------------------------

stat.test <- same_day_cross %>%
  pairwise_wilcox_test(
    cor ~ timepoint1,
    p.adjust.method = "BH"
  ) %>%
  add_significance("p.adj") %>% 
  add_y_position()

stat.test

# Keep only significant comparisons if desired
stat.test <- stat.test %>%
  filter(p.adj <= 0.05)


stat.test

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Plot
# ---------------------------------------------------------

plot <- ggplot(
  same_day_cross,
  aes(
    x = timepoint1,
    y = cor
  )
) +

  geom_boxplot(
    outlier.shape = NA
  ) +

  geom_jitter(
    width = 0.15,
    alpha = 0.4
  ) +

 stat_pvalue_manual(
    stat.test,
    label = "p.adj.signif",
    step.increase = 0.07
  ) +

  coord_cartesian(
    ylim = c(0.8, 1.00)
  ) +

  labs(
    title = "Cross-species (Human vs Chimp) correlation, matched timepoints \nkruskal.test pairwise_wilcox_test \n(p.adj=BH)",
    x = "Timepoint",
    y = "Spearman correlation"
  ) +

  theme_classic()

plot

plot <- ggplot(
  same_day_cross,
  aes(
    x = timepoint1,
    y = cor,
    group = 1
  )
) +

  stat_summary(
    fun = median,
    geom = "line"
  ) +

  stat_summary(
    fun = median,
    geom = "point",
    size = 2
  ) +

  stat_pvalue_manual(
    stat.test,
    label = "p.adj.signif",
    step.increase = 0.07
  ) +

  coord_cartesian(
    ylim = c(0.8, 1.00)
  ) +

  labs(
    title = "Cross-species (Human vs Chimp) correlation, matched timepoints \nLog2cpm >1 in at least 3/7 individuals \n at least 1 SpTp",
    x = "Timepoint",
    y = "Median Spearman correlation"
  ) +

  theme_classic()

plot

ggsave(
  "purity_plot.pdf",
  plot = plot,
  width = 5,
  height = 5
)
```

```{r , fig.width=5,fig.height=5}
Cor_log2cpm <- readRDS(
  "data/QC/concat/Cor_Filt_logcpm_G1_SpTp_RNA_TMM_log2cpm_No4_NoRep.RDS"
)

H_samples <- grep("^H", colnames(Cor_log2cpm), value = TRUE)
C_samples <- grep("^C", colnames(Cor_log2cpm), value = TRUE)

H_C_cor <- expand.grid(
  H_sample = H_samples,
  C_sample = C_samples,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

H_C_cor$Spearman <- mapply(
  function(h, c) Cor_log2cpm[h, c],
  H_C_cor$H_sample,
  H_C_cor$C_sample
)

H_C_cor$H_timepoint <- sub("^.*_(Day.*)$", "\\1", H_C_cor$H_sample)
H_C_cor$C_timepoint <- sub("^.*_(Day.*)$", "\\1", H_C_cor$C_sample)

head(H_C_cor)

timepoint_order <- c(
  "Day0", "Day2", "Day4","Day5", "Day15", "Day30"
)

H_C_cor$H_timepoint <- factor(
  H_C_cor$H_timepoint,
  levels = timepoint_order
)

H_C_cor$C_timepoint <- factor(
  H_C_cor$C_timepoint,
  levels = timepoint_order
)


table(H_C_cor$H_timepoint, H_C_cor$C_timepoint)


library(ggplot2)

ggplot(
  subset(H_C_cor, H_timepoint == "Day0"),
  aes(x = C_timepoint, y = Spearman, group = 1)
) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(
    x = "Chimpanzee developmental timepoint",
    y = "Spearman correlation",
    title = "Human Day0 vs. chimpanzee developmental trajectory"
  )

ggplot(
  H_C_cor,
  aes(x = C_timepoint, y = Spearman, group = H_timepoint, color = H_timepoint)
) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(
    x = "Chimpanzee developmental timepoint",
    y = "Spearman correlation",
    color = "Human timepoint"
  )

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

H_C_cor_median <- H_C_cor %>%
  group_by(H_timepoint, C_timepoint) %>%
  summarise(
    Median_Spearman = median(Spearman, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ggplot(
  H_C_cor_median,
  aes(
    x = C_timepoint,
    y = Median_Spearman,
    group = H_timepoint,
    color = H_timepoint
  )
) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(
    x = "Chimpanzee developmental timepoint",
    y = "Median Spearman correlation",
    color = "Human timepoint"
  )


H_C_cor_median <- H_C_cor %>%
  group_by(H_timepoint, C_timepoint) %>%
  summarise(
    Median_Spearman = median(Spearman, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ggplot(
  H_C_cor_median,
  aes(
    x = C_timepoint,
    y = H_timepoint,
    fill = Median_Spearman
  )
) +
  geom_tile() +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", Median_Spearman)),
    size = 3
  ) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    limits = c(0, 1),
    name = "Spearman\ncorrelation"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(
    x = "Chimpanzee developmental timepoint",
    y = "Human developmental timepoint"
  )
```

### No5

```{r}

metadata <- RNA_Metadata_No5
counts <- Filt_logcpm_G1_SpTp_RNA_fc_No5

# Make sure metadata follows the count matrix
metadata <- metadata[
    match(colnames(counts), metadata$SampleName),
]

metadata <- metadata %>% 
  filter(Individual != "H4R")

counts <- counts %>% 
  dplyr::select(-contains("R"))


Cor_log2cpm <- readRDS(
  "data/QC/concat/Cor_Filt_logcpm_G1_SpTp_RNA_TMM_log2cpm_No5_NoRep.RDS"
)


sample_info <- data.frame(
  sample    = colnames(Cor_log2cpm),
  species   = metadata$Species,
  timepoint = metadata$Timepoint
)


cor_long <- as.data.frame(Cor_log2cpm) %>%
  mutate(sample1 = rownames(Cor_log2cpm)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    -sample1,
    names_to = "sample2",
    values_to = "cor"
  ) %>%
  filter(sample1 != sample2) %>%
  left_join(
    sample_info,
    by = c("sample1" = "sample")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    species1 = species,
    timepoint1 = timepoint
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    sample_info,
    by = c("sample2" = "sample")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    species2 = species,
    timepoint2 = timepoint
  )


same_day_cross <- cor_long %>%
  filter(
    species1 != species2,
    timepoint1 == timepoint2
  ) %>%
  filter(species1 == "H") %>% 
  mutate(
    timepoint1 = factor(
      timepoint1,
      levels = c("Day0","Day2","Day4","Day15","Day30")
    )
  )


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Summary statistics
# ---------------------------------------------------------

summary_by_day <- same_day_cross %>%
  group_by(timepoint1) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_cor = mean(cor, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_cor = sd(cor, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n()
  )

summary_by_day


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Kruskal-Wallis test
# ---------------------------------------------------------

kruskal_res <- kruskal.test(
  cor ~ timepoint1,
  data = same_day_cross
)

kruskal_res


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# ALL pairwise Wilcoxon rank-sum tests
# ---------------------------------------------------------

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
# install.packages("rstatix")
library(rstatix)
# install.packages("ggpubr")
library(ggpubr)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Pairwise Wilcoxon tests with BH correction
# ---------------------------------------------------------

stat.test <- same_day_cross %>%
  pairwise_wilcox_test(
    cor ~ timepoint1,
    p.adjust.method = "BH"
  ) %>%
  add_significance("p.adj") %>% 
  add_y_position()

stat.test

# Keep only significant comparisons if desired
stat.test <- stat.test %>%
  filter(p.adj <= 0.05)


stat.test

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Plot
# ---------------------------------------------------------

plot <- ggplot(
  same_day_cross,
  aes(
    x = timepoint1,
    y = cor
  )
) +

  geom_boxplot(
    outlier.shape = NA
  ) +

  geom_jitter(
    width = 0.15,
    alpha = 0.4
  ) +

 stat_pvalue_manual(
    stat.test,
    label = "p.adj.signif",
    step.increase = 0.07
  ) +

  coord_cartesian(
    ylim = c(0.8, 1.00)
  ) +

  labs(
    title = "Cross-species (Human vs Chimp) correlation, matched timepoints \nDay4 Cardiac Mesoderm \nkruskal.test pairwise_wilcox_test \n(p.adj=BH)",
    x = "Timepoint",
    y = "Spearman correlation"
  ) +

  theme_classic()

plot

ggsave(
  "purity_plot.pdf",
  plot = plot,
  width = 5,
  height = 5
)

```

```{r}
  geom_jitter(
    width = 0.15,
    alpha = 0.4
  ) +

 stat_pvalue_manual(
    stat.test,
    label = "p.adj.signif",
    step.increase = 0.07
  ) +

  coord_cartesian(
    ylim = c(0.8, 1.05)
  ) +

  labs(
    title = "Cross-species (Chimp vs Chimp) correlation, matched timepoints \nkruskal.test pairwise_wilcox_test \n(p.adj=BH)",
    x = "Timepoint",
    y = "Spearman correlation"
  ) +

  theme_classic()

plot

ggsave(
  "purity_plot.pdf",
  plot = plot,
  width = 5,
  height = 5
)

```

## Log2cpm row means Greater than 0

### All days

```{r}

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggsignif)

metadata <- RNA_Metadata_NoRep
counts <- Filt_RMG0_RNA_fc %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  dplyr::select(-contains("R"))

# Make sure metadata follows the count matrix
metadata <- metadata[
    match(colnames(counts), metadata$SampleName),
]

metadata <- metadata %>% 
  filter(Individual != "H4R")

counts <- counts %>% 
  dplyr::select(-contains("R"))


Cor_log2cpm <- readRDS(
  "data/QC/concat/Cor_Filt_RMG0_RNA_log2cpm.RDS"
)


sample_info <- data.frame(
  sample    = colnames(Cor_log2cpm),
  species   = metadata$Species,
  timepoint = metadata$Timepoint
)


cor_long <- as.data.frame(Cor_log2cpm) %>%
  mutate(sample1 = rownames(Cor_log2cpm)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    -sample1,
    names_to = "sample2",
    values_to = "cor"
  ) %>%
  filter(sample1 != sample2) %>%
  left_join(
    sample_info,
    by = c("sample1" = "sample")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    species1 = species,
    timepoint1 = timepoint
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    sample_info,
    by = c("sample2" = "sample")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    species2 = species,
    timepoint2 = timepoint
  )


same_day_cross <- cor_long %>%
  filter(
    species1 != species2,
    timepoint1 == timepoint2
  ) %>%
  filter(species1 == "H") %>% 
  mutate(
    timepoint1 = factor(
      timepoint1,
      levels = c("Day0","Day2","Day4","Day5","Day15","Day30")
    )
  )


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Summary statistics
# ---------------------------------------------------------

summary_by_day <- same_day_cross %>%
  group_by(timepoint1) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_cor = mean(cor, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_cor = sd(cor, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n()
  )

summary_by_day


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Kruskal-Wallis test
# ---------------------------------------------------------

kruskal_res <- kruskal.test(
  cor ~ timepoint1,
  data = same_day_cross
)

kruskal_res


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# ALL pairwise Wilcoxon rank-sum tests
# ---------------------------------------------------------

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
# install.packages("rstatix")
library(rstatix)
# install.packages("ggpubr")
library(ggpubr)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Pairwise Wilcoxon tests with BH correction
# ---------------------------------------------------------

stat.test <- same_day_cross %>%
  pairwise_wilcox_test(
    cor ~ timepoint1,
    p.adjust.method = "BH"
  ) %>%
  add_significance("p.adj") %>% 
  add_y_position()

stat.test

# Keep only significant comparisons if desired
stat.test <- stat.test %>%
  filter(p.adj <= 0.05)


stat.test

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Plot
# ---------------------------------------------------------

plot <- ggplot(
  same_day_cross,
  aes(
    x = timepoint1,
    y = cor
  )
) +

  geom_boxplot(
    outlier.shape = NA
  ) +

  geom_jitter(
    width = 0.15,
    alpha = 0.4
  ) +

 stat_pvalue_manual(
    stat.test,
    label = "p.adj.signif",
    step.increase = 0.07
  ) +

  coord_cartesian(
    ylim = c(0.8, 1.00)
  ) +

  labs(
    title = "Cross-species (Human vs Chimp) correlation, matched timepoints \nkruskal.test pairwise_wilcox_test \n(p.adj=BH)",
    x = "Timepoint",
    y = "Spearman correlation"
  ) +

  theme_classic()

plot

ggsave(
  "purity_plot.pdf",
  plot = plot,
  width = 5,
  height = 5
)

```
